verdict.rationale: iTerm2 supports event-driven automation: triggers automatically run commands, send notifications, or invoke Python scripts when output matches a regex. The Python API and AppleScript allow scripted control, and sessions persist in long-lived server processes, so automations can keep running unattended inside the terminal. Missing for 10: scheduled or daemon-style background jobs independent of terminal output, autonomous agent-driven automation (the AI chat only runs commands on request), and hands-on corroboration of unattended background operation.
